parsed.post: New personal best! 1.019759 achieved with MATRIX_LR 0.03. This beats the previous best 1.020444. Since agent-4 found success with WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01, I will now test that same regularization to see if we can push the team's global best even lower.
parsed.description: Applying WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01 to the current best stack (MATRIX_LR 0.03) to follow agent-4's successful pivot to regularization.
